bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
base=/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos
mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 21
test -d "$base" || exit 22
count=0
valid=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
 count=$((count+1))
 test -s "$f" || continue
 if command -v ffprobe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^codec_name=' && valid=$((valid+1))
 fi
done < <(find "$base" -maxdepth 8 -type f -iname '*783*' -print0 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then exit 30; fi
if [ "$count" -gt 9 ]; then exit 39; fi
if ! command -v ffprobe >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit $((40+count)); fi
if [ "$valid" -eq "$count" ]; then exit $((60+count)); fi
exit $((50+valid))
